title: Implement real DAG executor with sub-phase wave execution

title: Build SwarmMail actor-model communication system

title: Integrate file reservations with swarm events
description: Integrated file reservations with SwarmMail events. ResourceManager broadcasts FILE_RESERVED on successful reservation.

title: Implement SPINE design specifications from PLAN.md
description: Completed all 10 implementation tasks across 4 priority areas. SwarmMail system, pre-check batch executor, ProviderConfig/plugin system, human handoff protocol, DAG executor, critic gate enforcement, LLMResponse dataclass, ContinuityManager/CheckpointPolicy, file reservation integration.

title: Add critic gate enforcement before EXECUTION phase
description: Added critic_gate_result field to SpineState, run_critic_gate() method, validation before EXECUTION transition, return_to_planning on rejection.

title: Add LLMResponse dataclass and confidence scoring
description: Added LLMResponse dataclass with content, usage, finish_reason, model, request_id. Added generate_with_confidence() method for confidence-weighted results.

description: Implemented ContinuityManager with restore_session(), _restore_checkpoint() methods. Added CheckpointPolicy with 6 trigger types per PERSISTENCE.md.
